desc: Don’t let its tiny size fool you. The all-new CTL is the smallest most versatile weapon light on the market today. It boasts a 525 lumen peak output plus up to 60 minutes of run time. The CTL also packs in the industry leading features you expect from Viridian such as the legendary patented INSTANT-ON tech. Introducing patent-pending SafeCharge, the gotta-have ultra convenient rechargeable power source system that is ready when you are. Also new is HRF the built-in Holster Retention Feature for better holster compatibility than ever possible before.
